source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U06: Distinguish principal capacity,agent responsibility and creation of authority

payload.title: Agency capacity has two different relationships
payload.core_explanation_md:
The principal appoints the agent to act or represent the principal in dealings with third parties. The principal capacity rule and the agent responsibility to the principal must be separated. Section184 wording permits any person to act as agent as between principal and third persons, while qualifying who is responsible to the principal. The textbook contradictory answer about minors should not override that distinction.

No consideration is necessary merely to create agency. Authority can be express or inferred from the relevant circumstances, but inference requires evidence. A person calling themselves agent does not establish every power they claim. Identify principal, third party, act and source of authority.

self_check.prompt_text: Does absence of an agency fee necessarily mean no agency can exist?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Creation of agency does not require consideration.

payload.stem_md: An agency is rejected solely because no fee was promised for the appointment. What does the creation rule require?

options.text_md: No consideration is necessary merely to create agency
options.explanation_md: Remuneration and creation are separate questions.

options.text_md: Every agent must receive a cash advance
options.explanation_md: The source does not impose that universal condition.
Authority can exist without a fee.

options.text_md: A fee alone establishes unlimited authority
options.explanation_md: Payment does not define the whole scope.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Remuneration and creation are separate questions.

payload.stem_md: A note treats agent capacity toward the principal as identical to capacity to represent the principal toward third parties. What is needed?

options.text_md: Assume every agent is personally liable for every transaction
options.explanation_md: Liability depends on the applicable rules.

options.text_md: Apply the separate section 184 relationships and responsibility conditions
options.explanation_md: One blanket statement misstates the source wording.

options.text_md: Use only the agent job title
options.explanation_md: Title is not the whole legal test.
